name: candleshop
title: CandleShop - E-commerce Opening Animation

overview.description: An elegant and immersive opening animation for an e-commerce candle website. Features an interactive SVG candle that lights up when clicked, triggering a radial reveal effect that unveils the full website content from center outward, creating a dramatic 'light spreading' visual metaphor.
overview.purpose: Creates a memorable first impression for an artisanal candle e-commerce site by using the product itself (a candle) as an interactive loading/intro animation. Enhances brand storytelling through animation.
overview.useCase: E-commerce website intros, brand storytelling, artisanal product sites, luxury retail, creative portfolios

visualEffects: Interactive SVG candle with realistic flame
Flame ignition animation with overshoot (scale 1.3) and settle
Continuous flame flicker animation (rotation + scale variations)
Radial overlay reveal from center (0% to 100% transparent circle)
Product cards staggered scroll-in animations (Intersection Observer)
Responsive hover effects on all interactive elements

keyFeatures: Full-screen loading screen with interactive candle
SVG with radial gradients for flame and glow effects
Error handling with fallback to show content

phases.description: Black fullscreen with unlit SVG candle centered
phases.elements: Candle visible, flame opacity 0, 'Light me up' text visible

phases.trigger: User clicks candle or presses Enter/Space
phases.animation: Flame appears with scale 0.3→1.3→1.0 and translateY motion
phases.description: Flame 'springs to life' with overshoot animation, glow appears simultaneously

phases.animation: Continuous flicker (1.5s cycle) and glow pulse (2s cycle)
phases.description: Flame oscillates realistically with rotation and scale, glow breathes in/out

phases.animation: Candle fades out (2s), radial overlay expands from center (1s)
phases.description: Light 'spreads' from candle position, revealing website content behind

phases.animation: Loading screen fades out (0.8s), main content fades in
phases.description: Full e-commerce site visible with header, hero, products sections

phases.animation: Product cards fade in with staggered timing (0.1s delay each)
phases.description: Cards translate from Y:30px to Y:0 with 0.6s ease timing

structure.candleBody: Rectangle with rounded corners (#f4f1e8 cream color, 50x120px)
structure.wick: Line from candle top extending upward (2px stroke)
structure.flame: Ellipse with radial gradient (yellow→orange→red), initially opacity:0
structure.glow: Circle with radial gradient (transparent at edges), initially opacity:0

animations.ignite: 0.8s once - flame appears with spring-like motion
animations.glow-appear: 0.8s once - glow fades in and expands

radialReveal.mechanism: Animated radial-gradient that expands transparent center from 0% to 100%
radialReveal.visualEffect: Creates illusion of light spreading radially from center where candle was lit
radialReveal.duration: 1 second (fast enough to feel dynamic, slow enough to appreciate)

initialization: DOM loads, overflow hidden to prevent scrolling
Candle container made focusable (tabindex=0) and keyboard accessible
Click and keyboard (Enter/Space) event listeners attached
Performance optimizations applied (check hardware, reduced motion)
userInteraction: User clicks candle or presses Enter/Space while focused
lightCandle() function called, state flags set (isLit=true, animationInProgress=true)
Cursor changes from pointer to default
Candle gets 'lighting' class, triggering flame ignition
revealSequence: Candle container fades out over 2s with scale increase
Radial overlay simultaneously expands transparent center over 1s
After 2s, loading screen hidden, main content made visible
Body overflow changed to auto (scrolling enabled)
After additional 800ms, loading screen removed from DOM
postReveal: Smooth scroll initialized for navigation links
Intersection Observer set up for product cards
Product cards animate in when scrolled into view (staggered by 0.1s each)

htmlStructure.candleContainer: Centered flex container with click handler
htmlStructure.candle: SVG with flame, glow, and gradient definitions
htmlStructure.radialOverlay: Fixed fullscreen overlay (z-index 999) for reveal effect
htmlStructure.mainContent: Initially hidden (opacity 0), contains full e-commerce site

stateVariables: isLit: boolean - whether candle has been lit
mainFunctions: lightCandle() - handles click/keyboard event, starts ignition
startRevealSequence() - orchestrates reveal and content display
initSmoothScroll() - sets up navigation link smooth scrolling
initScrollAnimations() - creates Intersection Observer for product cards
optimizeAnimations() - checks reduced motion and hardware performance

parameters.name: Ignition Duration
parameters.description: Time for flame to appear and settle
parameters.example: Change to 1.2s for slower, more dramatic ignition

parameters.name: Radial Reveal Speed
parameters.example: 2s for slower spread: animation: radial-reveal 2s ease-out forwards;

optimizations: Zero external libraries - total size ~20 KB
SVG is lightweight vector graphics (scales without quality loss)
Intersection Observer for efficient scroll animations (not listening to scroll events)
Loading screen removed from DOM after animation completes
Hardware concurrency detection to disable animations on weak devices
Error handling with fallback to immediately show content
considerations: Radial gradient animation can be GPU-intensive on old mobile devices
SVG filter (drop-shadow) adds small rendering cost
Multiple setTimeout calls (acceptable for one-time intro)
Product images are placeholder gradients (real images would need optimization)

features: Keyboard navigation: Tab to focus candle, Enter/Space to light
ARIA role='button' and aria-label on interactive candle
Error fallback ensures content always accessible
Semantic HTML structure for screen readers
improvements: Add screen reader announcement when animation starts/completes
Add 'Skip animation' button for users who prefer direct access
Add aria-live region to announce loading progress
Consider auto-starting animation after timeout for users who don't interact

advantages: Highly memorable and unique user experience
Reinforces brand identity (candle shop using candle animation)
Fully customizable colors, timing, and behavior
Responsive design works on all screen sizes
Accessible via keyboard and screen readers
limitations: Intro animation delays access to content (intentional, but not for all use cases)
Requires user interaction to proceed (may frustrate some users)
Radial gradient animation can lag on very old devices
Single-use animation (only plays once per page load)
Product images are placeholders (need to add real images)
